about: The pieces of Player 2 that only the Diagnostic Build carries (fw2/build.sh DIAG=1, the default; DIAG=0 is the normal build). Rule 5 of docs/PROJECT_RULES.md for fw2 (the register of fw/diag_features.json covers the old player): new diagnostic-only code is listed here and checked by sim/test_p2_diag_split.py, never a bare #if.
counters: fw2/diagnostics/info_counters.c: rows inside '#if P2_DIAG' are the Diagnostic Build's; every other row is the support set (the normal build's Report and the support fields of the About page)
counter_rows_note: SDA <SCAN|ENG|CPU> <REQ|WORDS|BUSY|WAIT|URGENT|BAD>: the per-port SDRAM statistics of tau_sdram_sched_v read through the MMIO window 0x1D4/0x1D8 (docs/MMIO_ALLOCATION.md), inside '#if P2_DIAG' in fw2/diagnostics/info_counters.c (the 54 bytes of shadow values and the refresh are also P2_DIAG only). The four wall-clock rows are the support set: the normal build's Report carries the host's boot time and the clock now. sim/test_p2_diag_split.py checks both lists against the cold image of each build.
